site.name: Alma Mine
overview: Alma Mine is a documented historic gold and silver mine in Ouray County. USGS-derived topographic records place the named mine on the Ironton quadrangle at approximately 37.948328, -107.656449, distinguishing this Ouray County site from same-name mines elsewhere in Colorado.
moreHistory: The retained evidence supports the mine's identity, Ouray County location, commodity association, and mapped position. A reliable operator chronology, production history, and present condition were not established from the available sources, so those details are left unstated.
